Professional Summary
DevOps Engineer with a focus on infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native operations. Open to relocating to Hyderabad or Kolkata. Immediate joiner.

Kubernetes, Terraform, SQS, S3, CloudWatch, CICD, Jenkins, Linux, Agile

- Integrated AWS CloudWatch alerts and SQS-based dead-letter handling for batch jobs to improve reliability and reduce incident response time.
- Collaborated in Agile sprint cycles to iterate on infrastructure requirements and delivered CICD improvements for faster release cadence.

DevOps Engineer, Quanta Retail (Apr 2023 - Nov 2023)
- Designed and maintained Jenkins pipelines for automated build, test and deploy workflows, achieving faster and more reliable releases.
- Managed Kubernetes clusters and node upgrades, ensuring zero-downtime deployments and improved resource utilization.
- Administered Linux servers for CI runners and application hosts, applying security hardening and automated configuration tasks.
- Implemented CICD best practices and integrated S3-based artifact storage and CloudWatch monitoring to streamline deployments and observability.
